title: PowerShell pipeline chain syntax is version-dependent
summary: A documented example, not an observed local success. Preserve conditional execution when adapting syntax.
symptom: The shell does not accept the pipeline chain operator.
cause: Hypothesis: the active session is Windows PowerShell 5.1 rather than PowerShell 7 or later.
resolution: Verify the active shell version; use a supported conditional success check rather than an unconditional semicolon.
verification: Documented by Microsoft about_Pipeline_Chain_Operators; verify the actual shell and authorized command outcome before marking observed-success.
